title: Flankers-FAR
description: EEG dataset from a visual word flanker task in which participants judged four-letter real words and pseudowords presented centrally, with no flankers, identical flankers, or different flankers. It was collected at the NeuroCognition Laboratory in San Diego to study orthographic processing and parafoveal flanker effects on word recognition. The dataset comprises 270 trials per participant with behavioral responses made via game controller.
methods_description: Participants sat in a darkened, sound-attenuated room and viewed a 24-inch LCD monitor. Stimuli were 90 four-letter real words and 90 pseudowords, each shown in three flanker conditions (no flanker, identical, different) for 270 trials. Each trial began with a purple fixation cross (1000 ms) and a white fixation cross (500 ms), then the stimulus for 150 ms, followed by a blank screen until a game-controller response.
